faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Research Fellow (SRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GBPUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form printed on page 1 of this notice) and send it to Principal Investigator, Dr. Ajay Kumar, Assistant Professor, Agronomy, at his departmental address (Department of Agronomy), G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar-263145, by by post, to reach by 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M. Sc. Ag (Agronomy/Soil Science/ Horticulture) with one year field experience in field crops and in laying demonstrations at farmer field.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Fellowship category is SC.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview on 13-11-2026 at 11:00 AM. No separate interview letter will be issued. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration of fellowship: six month. Appointment for six month, which may be extended as per requirement.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Department of Agronomy, G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Filled application form signed by the applicant; Attested copies of all certificates, degrees and testimonials; Originals to be produced at the time of interview.
